summary: BlackSky operates an AI-powered satellite intelligence platform — real-time Earth observation with sub-hourly revisit rates, processed by AI models for military, government, and commercial customers. In April 2026, BlackSky won a $30M defense contract extension for real-time ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance). The Golden Dome initiative explicitly requires space-based ISR sensor layers — BlackSky's core capability. Analyst targets range $30-42 (20-68% upside). Moon case: Black Sky wins a large Golden Dome ISR prime or major DoD intelligence contract = $75 (201% upside).

catalysts.name: Golden Dome ISR Layer — Space Intelligence Requirement
catalysts.description: Golden Dome ($151B) requires space-based ISR sensor coverage to detect and track incoming missiles. BlackSky's AI satellite intelligence platform — real-time Earth observation with sub-hourly revisit rates — is precisely the ISR capability Golden Dome needs. Pentagon awarding ISR contracts H2 2026.

catalysts.name: $30M Defense Contract + NRO/NGA Pipeline
catalysts.description: BlackSky won a $30M defense contract in April 2026 for real-time ISR services. NRO (National Reconnaissance Office) and NGA (National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency) are both expanding AI satellite intelligence procurement. BKSY's next contract expansion could be 3-5x the April award.

catalysts.name: Commercial Customer Expansion — AI Analytics Platform
catalysts.description: Beyond defense: BlackSky's Spectra AI platform is now sold commercially — supply chain monitoring, agricultural intelligence, infrastructure monitoring. Commercial diversification reduces binary defense risk. Expanding into Ukraine conflict monitoring + critical infrastructure protection = non-defense revenue.

risks: Near-profit but not yet — generating ~$100M revenue; still reaching sustained FCF positive
Satellite constellation is small (16 satellites) vs Planet Labs (200+) — coverage gap risk
Golden Dome ISR competition: Planet Labs, MAXAR, Satellogic, Umbra all bidding same contracts
Customer concentration risk: majority of revenue from US government — single customer category dependency
Stock already up ~80% from 2025 lows — partial Golden Dome re-rate may already be priced in

estimateDates.event: Golden Dome ISR Contract Awards H2 2026
estimateDates.note: Even a subcontract for real-time ISR = re-rate trigger. Prime = moon case.
Follow-on to Apr $30M — next award likely 3-5x larger given satellite expansion

analystTargets.note: Golden Dome ISR opportunity + contract expansion

macroRisk.rateOutlook: US government ISR contracts (NRO, NGA, DoD) are multi-year appropriations — not rate sensitive. Golden Dome is a presidential mandate with bipartisan support and dedicated funding.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Satellite operations have fixed launch costs already sunk. Ground software and AI analytics are high-margin — minimal inflation pass-through risk.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: LOW impact. Government intelligence contract revenue is Fed-independent. Commercial diversification adds some macro sensitivity but is currently a small % of revenue.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW. Government ISR contracts are the primary driver — independent of Fed rate decisions. Key risk is contract win/loss competition, not macro.

postWin.note: Planet Labs (PL) +85% in 2 months on NOAA and DoD contract expansions in 2024. Satellogic +120% on multi-year DoD ISR contract. BKSY's $30M April contract already showed the pattern — next contract 3-5x larger could generate proportionally larger move.

postLose.note: BlackSky missed a major NGA contract in 2023, falling 40% from its prior high. Losing the Golden Dome ISR bid would trigger a similar selloff — especially if Planet Labs or Umbra wins the prime.

spotSizing.reason: Smallest pure ค่าขนม sizing (2%) because: (1) partial Golden Dome re-rate already in price, (2) strong competition from Planet Labs + Umbra + MAXAR. Add more only after contract confirmed.

comparableCases.note: Planet Labs +85% in 2 months on combined NOAA weather data contract + DoD ISR expansion. BlackSky Spectra AI is the next-generation equivalent — AI-processed real-time ISR vs raw satellite imagery. BKSY's Golden Dome win would trigger the same institutional re-rating.

MAXAR Technologies +60% in 30 days on NRO long-duration ISR contract. BKSY's equivalent would be an NGA/NRO contract win — the existing $30M April contract shows BKSY already in the procurement pipeline.
BlackSky itself +45% in 2 weeks after the $30M defense contract was announced in April 2026. The Golden Dome ISR award will be 5-10x larger — proportional re-rate could reach 200%+ at $75 moon case.
